name: Nadeem Mumtaz
shortBio: Leads Alliance Solutions with a focus on dependable supply, honest pricing and long-term client relationships.
bio: Nadeem Mumtaz leads Alliance Solutions, an industrial supplies company based at Rania Mall, Bank Road, Rawalpindi. He works directly with plants, contractors and workshops to make sure every order — from a single drum of solvent to a full fastener schedule — arrives complete, documented and on time.

His approach is hands-on: qualifying vendors personally, reviewing specifications with clients before they buy, and keeping the lines of communication open long after the invoice. That discipline is what turns a supplier into a partner.
quote: Reliable supply is not a promise — it is a process we run every day.

experience.title: Founder & CEO
experience.description: Leads supply operations, the vendor network and key client relationships across Pakistan.
